correctness.rationale: Unique direct-sum decreasing-block decomposition gives exactly 2^(n-1) uniform cut strings, with first-order interpretations in both directions between two orders and binary successor cut predicate with terminal sentinel. First-order word languages are regular, giving an effectively computed rational generating series F(z). Braunfeld-Kukla first-order convergence supplies existence, and the Abel limit p=lim_(s->1-)(1-s)F(s/2) is rational because the removable singularity has rational coefficients. For any q, choose q equal-length distinct words u avoiding 00, and markers w=001u1. Prefix-suffix nonoverlap proves switching the earliest marker gives an exact bijection among all q types at every finite length. Disjoint windows give exponentially decaying probability of no marker, and earliest-marker types are FO-definable; their unions yield each m/q. Fresh finite enumeration checks cut permutations and first-hit symmetry but unrestricted reasoning is combinatorial and logical.
